description: List every food category in which a given food additive is permitted under the Codex GSFA, with the maximum use level for each. Separates Table 1 and 2 provisions (which carry a specific maximum level) from Table 3 provisions (permitted under good manufacturing practice with no numeric limit). Use to see the full permitted scope of one additive across all foods.

additive.description: INS number, name, or synonym — e.g. "415", "xanthan gum".

table.description: Filter to one table: "table1_2" or "table3". Omit for both.

name: gsfa_additive_provisions
title: Gsfa Additive Provisions
